description:
The process begins when a customer files a complaint about a product or service.
Customer service logs the complaint and assigns it to the relevant department for investigation.
After reviewing the details, the team determines whether the complaint is valid and whether a refund is justified and notifies the customer with the decision.
If a refund is approved, the financial team processes the reimbursement.
The complaint is marked as resolved once the customer receives the refund or directly after notifying the customer in case the refund was rejected.
After resolving the case, customers can provide feedback on their satisfaction.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_Complaint" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/complaint-handling">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Complaint">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Company" processRef="Process_ComplaintHandling"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ComplaintFiled" name="Complaint filed" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_ComplaintFiled"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DecisionNotified" name="Decision notification" sourceRef="SendTask_NotifyDecision" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RefundPaid" name="Refund paid" sourceRef="Task_ProcessRefund" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FeedbackProvided" name="Feedback provided" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Event_FeedbackReceived"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ComplaintFiled" name="Complaint filed"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_DecisionNotified" name="Decision notification"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_RefundPaid" name="Refund paid"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_FeedbackProvided" name="Feedback provided"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_ComplaintHandling" name="Complaint Handling" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Company">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_CustomerService" name="Customer Service">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_ComplaintFiled</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_LogComplaint</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssignComplaint</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ResolutionMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_MarkResolved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_FeedbackReceived</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_ComplaintClosed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_RelevantDepartment" name="Relevant Department">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReviewComplaint</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SendTask_NotifyDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RefundDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_FinancialTeam" name="Financial Team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProcessRefund</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_ComplaintFiled" name="Complaint filed">
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ComplaintFiled" messageRef="Msg_ComplaintFiled"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_LogComplaint" name="Log complaint">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssignComplaint" name="Assign complaint to relevant department">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewComplaint" name="Review complaint and decide validity and refund justification">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_NotifyDecision" name="Notify customer of decision" messageRef="Msg_DecisionNotified">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RefundDecision" name="Refund approved?" default="SequenceFlow_RefundRejected">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_RefundApproved</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_RefundRejected</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProcessRefund" name="Process reimbursement">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_RefundApproved</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ResolutionMerge" name="Case ready for resolution">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_RefundRejected</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_MarkResolved" name="Mark complaint as resolved">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_FeedbackReceived" name="Customer feedback received">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_FeedbackReceived" messageRef="Msg_FeedbackProvided"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ComplaintClosed" name="Complaint closed">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_10</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_ComplaintFiled" targetRef="Task_LogComplaint"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_2" sourceRef="Task_LogComplaint" targetRef="Task_AssignComplaint"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_3" sourceRef="Task_AssignComplaint" targetRef="Task_ReviewComplaint"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_4" sourceRef="Task_ReviewComplaint" targetRef="SendTask_NotifyDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_5" sourceRef="SendTask_NotifyDecision" targetRef="Gateway_RefundDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_RefundApproved" name="Refund approved" sourceRef="Gateway_RefundDecision" targetRef="Task_ProcessRefund">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">${refundApproved}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_RefundRejected" name="Refund rejected" sourceRef="Gateway_RefundDecision" targetRef="Gateway_ResolutionMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_7" sourceRef="Task_ProcessRefund" targetRef="Gateway_ResolutionMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_8" sourceRef="Gateway_ResolutionMerge" targetRef="Task_MarkResolved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_9" sourceRef="Task_MarkResolved" targetRef="Event_FeedbackReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_10" sourceRef="Event_FeedbackReceived" targetRef="EndEvent_ComplaintClosed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
